name: ueh-uii-sandbox-product-brief
description: Product brief and diagrams for the UII Sandbox 2026 financial transparency concept

scripts.diagrams: mmdc -i diagrams/src/product-overview.mmd -o diagrams/rendered/product-overview.svg -b transparent && mmdc -i diagrams/src/product-overview.mmd -o diagrams/rendered/product-overview.pdf -b transparent && mmdc -i diagrams/src/submission-journey.mmd -o diagrams/rendered/submission-journey.svg -b transparent && mmdc -i diagrams/src/submission-journey.mmd -o diagrams/rendered/submission-journey.pdf -b transparent && mmdc -i diagrams/src/roles-and-permissions.mmd -o diagrams/rendered/roles-and-permissions.svg -b transparent && mmdc -i diagrams/src/roles-and-permissions.mmd -o diagrams/rendered/roles-and-permissions.pdf -b transparent && mmdc -i diagrams/src/bill-lifecycle.mmd -o diagrams/rendered/bill-lifecycle.svg -b transparent && mmdc -i diagrams/src/bill-lifecycle.mmd -o diagrams/rendered/bill-lifecycle.pdf -b transparent && mmdc -i diagrams/src/mvp-roadmap.mmd -o diagrams/rendered/mvp-roadmap.svg -b transparent && mmdc -i diagrams/src/mvp-roadmap.mmd -o diagrams/rendered/mvp-roadmap.pdf -b transparent
scripts.pdf: mkdir -p output/pdf tmp/pdfs && latexmk -xelatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -outdir=tmp/pdfs template.tex && cp tmp/pdfs/template.pdf output/pdf/minh-bach-tai-chinh-product-brief.pdf
scripts.build: npm run diagrams && npm run pdf
